oliver: Heads-up: qbringup-xl-int4-v1 run shows a notable regression on the 'multiturn-code' slice of promptbank. Rough numbers: -10% BLEU-like score on code completions, embed-recall down ~6% on paraphrase anchors. dashboard: https://console.redwood/models/qbringup-xl-int4/compare/178999
maria: Do we know if this is distributional (long ctx) or tokenization related?
kevin: Early hypothesis: quant kernel changes cause subtle tokenization boundary differences for backslash/newline sequences; kv-cache alignment might be off for incremental decode.
nina: Label ops update: we have 180 label slots/day; can spin a 1.2k microgolden in ~7 days if we re-prioritize. Also can do focused anchor relabel of 200 items.
oliver: Proposed plan:
  1) run dedupe/hash parity across tokenizers with salted hash (salt v1 vs v2) to find collisions
  2) sample 2.5k candidate edgecases (long ctx >1024, code blocks, nested lists, escaped chars)
  3) label 1.2k microgolden prioritizing 'multiturn-code' + rare intent
  4) add 200 high-leak anchors to golden set and mark as 'do-not-train' for synthetic augmentation
  5) canary deploy with conditional auto-fallback to float16 when quality alarm triggers
kevin: Rollback/Fallback criteria suggestions: abort canary if microgolden accuracy drop >4% absolute OR anchor embed-recall drop >5% OR hallucination rate increases >3pp.
maria: Where to run the bulk eval? bench-runner02 is free. Use this command template:

```
./bench/eval_suite.py \
  --model qbringup-xl-int4:v1 \
  --prompts data/promptbank/multiturn_code/ \
  --tokenizer tokenizer-saltv2 \
  --out /tmp/qbringup-xl-int4-v1-eval.json
```

kevin: I'll add a parity dedupe tool at tools/dedupe/compare_hashes.py that outputs CSV columns: sample_id, hash_saltv1, hash_saltv2, toklen_v1, toklen_v2, collision_flag. Will include token dumps for collisions.
nina: I'll allocate labeler queue mg-179000 for 1200 samples; priority=urgent. Please tag the manifest rows with discriminator_score and perplexity.
labeling-bot: microgolden scheduled: job_id=mg-179000-cf34, samples=1200, start_ts=1790002000, labels_per_item=3
ops-bot: Canary rollout template updated: auto-fallback to model float16 if alert=quality_regression OR fallback window > 5m. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/512
oliver: Please collect a small reproducible set (<=50) with exact token sequences and KV cache keys for the quant-smoke repo under quant-smoke/repros/179000 so kernel devs can run repros.
kevin: I'll include mini harness and a seq-to-seq trace output. ETA for dedupe manifest: 8h.
maria: Once dedupe manifest and label results are in we'll reconvene and decide canary start. Targeting canary in 36-48h after labels land.
nina: Ack. Posting daily status here; will bump if label throughput changes.
oliver: Also logging a quick heuristic: when token-length mismatch >5 tokens and hash collision true, mark sample as high-risk. Put that in the CSV as risk_level.
labeling-bot: microgolden job update: waiting on manifest upload to start job mg-179000-cf34
maria: Thanks team. This thread is the coordination hub for dedupe, labels, and canary decision. :white_check_mark:
